portal: https://www.ownerinfo.landrover.com/ (iGuide Online; linked from https://www.landroverusa.com/ownership/owners-library/index.html). Note: ownerinfo.landrover.com without 'www' does not resolve (DNS) as of check date.
notes: Free, no VIN/account: iGuide Online (formerly Digital Handbook) lets you pick vehicle + model year after choosing site language/market (English (USA/Canada) + United States, stored in a session cookie; the VIN box is optional and was not used). Documents are HTML handbooks, no PDF download exists on the portal. Document IDs are market-specific (same model/year gives a different ID for other markets) and a direct document URL redirects to the home page until the language/market is selected in that browser session. Index endpoint used: /model/{lineCode}/years/{year}/index (JSON). Line codes: LK=Range Rover L405, 3K=New Range Rover L460 (portal also lists 3K for 2022), LX=RR Sport L494, 3R=New RR Sport L461, LH=Evoque L538, 3G=New Evoque L551, 3A=Discovery Sport. Some years list two variants (with/without CD player / InControl Touch vs Touch Pro); 2016 Evoque also has a Convertible handbook. MY2014-2015 RR/RRS/Evoque and LR2 are not in the US model list; the portal points to TOPIx (JLR technical portal, registration required). landroverusa.com ownership/warranty pages contain no PDF handbooks or warranty booklets.
